statement: Requirements: **Two-row layout is DESKTOP-ONLY (`d-none d-lg-flex`).** Below `lg`, a **retained mobile header** (`d-lg-none`) keeps today's mobile-visible children: **logo + store icon + account link** (see Architecture). Nothing that renders on mobile today may be deleted.
subject: Requirements

statement: Requirements: Account + cart move into row 2 on **desktop**, keeping cart indicator, buy-alert, and free-ship popup behavior. On mobile they stay where they render today (account in the retained mobile header; cart via `mew_mobi_bar.liquid` where present).
subject: Requirements

statement: Requirements: Non-functional: no regression to the mobile header, `#col-left-mew` mobile drawer, `mew_mobi_bar.liquid` bottom bar, or the horizontal "Sản phẩm" mega-menu. No new external assets. Keep Bootstrap 4 grid utility classes already in use.
subject: Requirements

statement: Implementation Steps: **Mobile branch** `.row.header-row-mobile.d-lg-none`: logo + store icon (`d-flex`, mobile) + account link — preserve the currently mobile-visible children. **Do not delete them.**
subject: Implementation Steps

statement: Implementation Steps: **Desktop branch** `.header-desktop.d-none.d-lg-flex.flex-column` containing Row 1 + Row 2.

statement: Requirements: Hovering a category with children reveals a mega-menu flyout to the right: child columns (brand headings) with grandchild links (series), like the reference.

statement: Requirements: New setting `header_bar_bg` (color) → background of `.header-row-bottom` (the menu bar) and DANH MỤC button/panel header.

statement: Requirements: New setting `header_bar_text` (color) → text/icon color of the bar: DANH MỤC label, account/cart labels, search-input affordances that sit on the bar.

statement: Requirements: Changing either setting recolors the bar live in the theme editor with no hard-coded color winning.

statement: Requirements: Non-functional: colors delivered via CSS custom properties (existing `head_styles.liquid` pattern), not inline per-element styles. Sensible defaults so the header looks correct before the merchant changes anything.

statement: rule section: Per-group collection filter convention
subject: Per-group collection filter convention

statement:
Rules: Each `
...
` heading becomes a filter block title.
subject: Rules

statement:
Rules: The text **after** each `` and **before** the next `
` (or end of description) is treated as a comma-separated tag list.
subject: Rules

statement: Rules: Tags are trimmed and slugified — case and extra whitespace are tolerated.
subject: Rules

statement: Rules: Tags must match product tags on the collection's products exactly (the parser does not validate existence — a tag with no matching products renders as an empty checkbox group).
subject: Rules

statement: Rules: Groups filter independently: checking "tag-a" in group 1 only filters by `tag-a`, not by tags from group 2.
subject: Rules

statement: Rules: The existing price, vendor, and type filter blocks are unaffected — they render above the `<h5>` groups per `aside-filter.liquid`.
subject: Rules

statement: Requirements: Functional: grid product-card titles wrap to a maximum of 2 lines with ellipsis clamp on overflow.
subject: Requirements

statement: Requirements: Non-functional: uniform card height preserved across all grid variants; no layout shift (CLS) introduced.
subject: Requirements

statement: Requirements: Functional: **all** groups collapsed on open (Validation Session 1 decision — matches the note "thu gọn lại"); per-group `+`/`−` toggle expands/collapses only that group; independent of other groups.
subject: Requirements

statement: Requirements: Non-functional: desktop menu unchanged; no dependency on collection-page-only scripts (panel is site-wide); accessible tap target; no layout jump.
subject: Requirements

statement: Requirements: Functional: on a configured collection, the sidebar renders one filter block per category group, each listing only that group's tags.
subject: Requirements

statement: Requirements: Non-functional: no new filter engine; use existing `filter-cate-col-sn.liquid`. Document the authoring convention so remaining collections can be populated by the client without code changes.
subject: Requirements
